profile.headline: Software Engineer at Privia Health
profile.summary:
Howdy! I am a passionate, curious, and versatile software engineering professional with a focus in web-based technologies and their implementation on the front-end. I am always looking for opportunities to apply my passion for software engineering and teaching others, whether that be working on either side of the development stack or leading tech talks and knowledge-share sessions with my teammates. 

I am currently a software engineer working on the marketing site at CallRail where I have built the following skills up:

Web/ full-stack development
- JavaScript
- Vue.js
- Angular
- TypeScript
- GraphQL
- Bootstrap 5
- CSS/SCSS
- Grid and Flexbox/ Responsive web design
- Ruby
- Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Assisting in leading migration efforts of Callrail.com's company website from Vue to Angular.
• Created a system to track and correct deprecating technologies in older iterations of our tech stack
• Started and hosted monthly technical talks for team engagement and knowledge transfer
• Started initiative to transfer knowledge of Typescript to fellow teammates through group-learning sessions
• Mentoring and supervising incoming interns

positions.title: Jr. Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Primary duties included assisting with efforts towards migrating the company’s Wordpress frontend website to Vue.js paired with the Gridsome framework.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description: Instructed three levels of HTML/CSS, Python and Java workshops during the summer of 2019 for Georgia State students, faculty, and non-students throughout the course of the semester. Attendees learned the basics of programming through a series of small projects.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Tested and debugged the iOS application to ensure that all bugs and warnings were addressed, 
•  Reengineered and refactored application code to optimize performance.
•  Created bug and warning reports to track past issues and resolutions.
•  Researched more efficient APIs and frameworks that would help speed the various application components such as animations.
• Wrote code to make sure that profile pages on both the iOS and web clients were identical.

Technologies used: Swift, Xcode, Quick and Nimble, HTML, CSS, Ruby on Rails, ERB, Sass, Github, Git, CircleCi.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a team to create a new website for photographer Theron Humphery using designs created by the client and the team leader. Created the Home and about page.

Technologies used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description: Tasked with assisting the Executive Producer in setting up productions.

positions.title: HackGSU iOS application Software Developer
positions.description: During Fall 2016, I was a part of a team of 5 developers who were tasked to create the Mobile and web applications for HackGSU. The team that I was a part of created the iOS application. My specific duties were to create the about page for the application, which I used Swift and Xcode to develop.

honors.title: #HackHarrassment and Best Design awards at HackGSU
honors.description:
My team and I created Expresso, an application that connects people who are not feeling well emotionally to individuals who can help them through a one on one chat or a group chat.

Link to the project: https://devpost.com/software/expresso-mr1d2x

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored high school student who have an interest in Computer Science on the basics of programing through various projects using Scratch.
Worked with my team and other PantherHackers committees to best achieve our mission of creating a tight-knit and encouraging Computer Science community of students at Georgia State University.

organizations.name: /dev/color
organizations.description: Current member of /dev/color where I work with other Black engineers and technologists to build a sense of community, helping one another to grow.

organizations.name: Black and Brown ERG
organizations.description: I co-created and am currently the vice chair of an employee resource group (ERG) at CallRail where our goal is to build community for employees of color at CallRail. We do this through various virtual engagement events where we discuss current and past issues, career growth, and empowerment. The org currently has 100+ members and is continuing to grow.
